title: GUARD: Guided Unlearning and Retention via Data Attribution for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.10946v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unlearning large language models (LLMs) is important due to copyright and privacy concerns. A key challenge is unintended forgetting, where removing data inadvertently impairs model utility. While prior work has focused on architectural innovations, the influence of data-level factors remains underexplored. We introduce GUARD, a framework for **G**uided **U**nlearning **A**nd **R**etention via **D**ata Attribution. GUARD uses a lightweight proxy data attribution metric tailored to LLM unlearning, which efficiently quantifies the "alignment" between the Forget and Retain (or synthetic supplement) Sets. This metric leads to a new unlearning objective that assigns adaptive, nonuniform weights to samples, decaying exponentially with their proxy attribution scores, and thereby provably mitigates unintended retention loss. On the TOFU benchmark with a 10% forget set, applying GUARD to Gradient Ascent (GA) improves Retain Set ROUGE-L

translated_title: GUARD：基于数据归因的大语言模型引导式遗忘与保持
translated_abstract: 出于版权和隐私方面的考虑，大语言模型（LLM）的遗忘技术变得非常重要。一个关键挑战是非预期遗忘，即移除数据时会无意中损害模型的效用。尽管先前的工作主要聚焦于架构层面的创新，但数据层面因素的影响仍鲜有探索。我们提出了GUARD，一个通过数据归因实现引导式遗忘与保持的框架。GUARD采用一种为LLM遗忘量身定制的轻量级代理数据归因度量，能够高效量化遗忘集与保留集（或合成补充集）之间的“对齐”程度。该度量催生了一种新的遗忘目标：为样本分配自适应的非均匀权重，且权重随其代理归因分数呈指数衰减，从而可被证明地减轻非预期的保留性能损失。在采用10%遗忘集的TOFU基准上，将GUARD应用于梯度上升（GA）方法可提升保留集的ROUGE-L……
tldr: GUARD框架利用轻量级数据归因度量，为遗忘样本分配随归因分数指数衰减的自适应非均匀权重，在大语言模型遗忘过程中可证明地缓解非预期遗忘、保持模型效用。
en_tdlr: GUARD employs a lightweight data attribution metric to assign adaptive, exponentially-decaying nonuniform weights to samples during LLM unlearning, provably mitigating unintended forgetting while preserving model utility.
